sessions.phase_label: Scope clarification, implementation, delivery, and deployment dispute

requirements.title: Web Application
requirements.definition: Provide a functional web application for the billing and invoicing system.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the web client deliverable; mobile, desktop, and administrative clients are independently deliverable applications.

requirements.title: Android Application
requirements.definition: Provide the Android build of the mobile billing application.
requirements.boundary_note: The Android application can be built, tested, and distributed independently from the iOS application.

requirements.title: iOS Application
requirements.definition: Provide the iOS build of the mobile billing application.
requirements.boundary_note: The iOS application can be built, tested, and distributed independently from the Android application.

requirements.title: Windows Application
requirements.definition: Provide a Windows desktop build of the billing application.
requirements.boundary_note: Windows is an independently buildable desktop target explicitly required by the job specification.

requirements.title: macOS Application
requirements.definition: Provide a macOS desktop build of the billing application.
requirements.boundary_note: macOS is an independently buildable desktop target explicitly required by the job specification.

requirements.title: Administrative Panel
requirements.definition: Provide an administrative interface for managing the billing platform.
requirements.boundary_note: The administrative panel is independently requested and should not be merged into the ordinary web application.

requirements.title: Flutter Client Technology
requirements.definition: Implement the supported client applications using Flutter.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the shared client-framework constraint; the individual platform applications remain separate deliverables.

requirements.title: NestJS Backend
requirements.definition: Implement the server-side application and APIs using NestJS with TypeScript.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the mandatory backend framework rather than the independently specified database, ORM, or cache technologies.

requirements.title: PostgreSQL Database
requirements.definition: Use PostgreSQL as the persistent relational database.
requirements.boundary_note: PostgreSQL is a database-engine constraint that can change independently from the ORM choice.

requirements.title: Prisma ORM
requirements.definition: Use Prisma ORM for application access to the relational data layer.
requirements.boundary_note: Prisma is an independently replaceable data-access constraint rather than an attribute of PostgreSQL.

requirements.title: Redis Service
requirements.definition: Include Redis as the required in-memory infrastructure service.
requirements.boundary_note: Redis is an independently deployable infrastructure dependency and is not merged with the primary database.

requirements.title: Multi-Company Support
requirements.definition: Allow the billing platform to maintain and operate multiple companies as distinct organizational entities.
requirements.boundary_note: Company tenancy can evolve independently from the number and permissions of users.

requirements.title: Multi-User Support
requirements.definition: Allow multiple users to access and use the billing platform.
requirements.boundary_note: User access is independently testable from company tenancy and may require separate authentication and authorization behavior.

requirements.title: Optional Indian GST Support
requirements.definition: Support Indian GST invoicing while allowing GST behavior to remain optional when it is not applicable.
requirements.boundary_note: GST calculation and presentation form one configurable tax mechanism rather than a general invoice feature area.

requirements.title: Multiple Invoice Templates
requirements.definition: Allow invoices to be rendered using multiple selectable templates.
requirements.boundary_note: Template selection is independent from PDF generation and sharing behavior.

requirements.title: PDF Invoice Generation
requirements.definition: Generate invoices as PDF documents.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers creation of the PDF artifact; distributing that artifact is independently testable sharing behavior.

requirements.title: PDF Invoice Sharing
requirements.definition: Provide a share action for PDF invoices with channels such as WhatsApp, Gmail, and a shareable link.
requirements.boundary_note: Sharing is an independent post-generation behavior; the listed channels are attributes of that mechanism.

requirements.title: CSV and Spreadsheet Import
requirements.definition: Import billing data from CSV, XLS, and XLSX files.
requirements.boundary_note: Import has separate parsing, validation, and persistence behavior from export; file formats remain attributes.

requirements.title: CSV and Spreadsheet Export
requirements.definition: Export billing data in CSV, XLS, and XLSX formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Export can be implemented or fail independently from import; output formats remain attributes.

requirements.title: Daily Automatic Backup
requirements.definition: Automatically create a backup of application data each day.
requirements.boundary_note: Backup scheduling and creation are independently testable from restoration of a saved backup.

requirements.title: Backup Restoration
requirements.definition: Restore application data from a previously created backup.
requirements.boundary_note: Restoration has a separate success criterion from automatic backup generation.

requirements.title: Responsive Mobile-First Interface
requirements.definition: Provide a responsive, mobile-first interface across supported screen sizes.
requirements.boundary_note: Layout responsiveness is independently testable from visual palette and typography choices.

requirements.title: Elegant Professional Visual Design
requirements.definition: Use an elegant, restrained professional visual style and color palette.
requirements.boundary_note: Color and general styling are attributes of one visual-design mechanism; typography has a distinct modification trajectory.

requirements.title: Professional Interface Typography
requirements.definition: Use interface typography that is not excessively heavy and presents a professional appearance.
requirements.boundary_note: The client establishes the need to replace the heavy typography; Gotham Pro is a freelancer proposal whose final authority requires Event-level review.

requirements.title: Email One-Time-Password Authentication
requirements.definition: Send one-time passwords by email as part of the application's authentication flow.
requirements.boundary_note: The OTP behavior is identifiable, but the messages do not establish a final email-delivery provider.

requirements.title: Complete Source Code Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the complete codebase, including client applications, administrative interface, and backend source.
requirements.boundary_note: Completeness across component codebases is the acceptance criterion for one source-delivery artifact.

requirements.title: Database Schema and Migrations
requirements.definition: Deliver the database schema and executable database migrations.
requirements.boundary_note: Schema and migration files form one tightly coupled database-initialization deliverable.

requirements.title: API Documentation
requirements.definition: Deliver documentation for the backend APIs.
requirements.boundary_note: API reference material is an independent artifact from deployment and general setup documentation.

requirements.title: Project Setup Guide
requirements.definition: Deliver instructions for installing and configuring the project.
requirements.boundary_note: General local setup is distinct from the requested step-by-step production deployment procedure.

requirements.title: Project README
requirements.definition: Deliver a project README describing the software and its use.
requirements.boundary_note: The README is a named deliverable and is not assumed to replace API or deployment documentation.

requirements.title: Step-by-Step Deployment Guide
requirements.definition: Deliver a file containing step-by-step instructions that a server administrator can use to deploy the project.
requirements.boundary_note: The deployment document is independently required even if actual server deployment is performed by another person.

requirements.title: Clean and Maintainable Codebase
requirements.definition: Provide clean, scalable, reviewed, tested, and adequately documented production-ready code.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a code-quality acceptance constraint; separately named documentation artifacts remain independent Requirements.

requirements.title: Docker and Docker Compose Deployment
requirements.definition: Package and configure the application for deployment with Docker and Docker Compose.
requirements.boundary_note: Docker configuration is a persistent deployment mechanism; performing a one-time release to the client's VPS is separate.

requirements.title: Hosted Review Environment
requirements.definition: Provide a live hosted environment that the non-technical client can access to review and test the application.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a temporary accessible environment deliverable, not a generic testing-process Requirement or the final production release.

requirements.title: Deployment to Client Ubuntu VPS
requirements.definition: Deploy the completed project to the client's Ubuntu VPS.
requirements.boundary_note: Actual server release is independently actionable from providing Docker configuration or written deployment instructions.

requirements.title: Google Play Store Release
requirements.definition: Release the Android application through the client's Google Play developer account.
requirements.boundary_note: Google Play submission has platform-specific credentials and acceptance steps independent from App Store release.

requirements.title: Apple App Store Release
requirements.definition: Release the iOS application through the client's Apple App Store developer account.
requirements.boundary_note: App Store submission has platform-specific credentials and acceptance steps independent from Google Play release.

requirements.title: Secure Production-Ready Implementation
requirements.definition: Ensure security remains a major implementation and deployment acceptance concern for the production system.
requirements.boundary_note: This records the explicit global security constraint; repository confidentiality and incident-specific configuration replacement have separate actions and trajectories.

requirements.title: Private Source Repository
requirements.definition: Restrict source-repository access so the project code and configuration are not publicly exposed.
requirements.boundary_note: Repository visibility has its own public-to-private failure and fix trajectory, distinct from rotating exposed API configuration.

requirements.title: Replacement of Exposed API Configuration
requirements.definition: Replace API endpoint configuration that was exposed while the source repository was public.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an incident-specific configuration remediation task and is independently actionable after repository access is restricted.

unresolved_candidates.description: The job refers to a detailed attached feature specification, but its contents are not supplied; additional independent Requirements may therefore be missing from the observable inventory.
Email OTP is identifiable, but the intended provider and whether administrators must receive a manual service-API configuration field are not client-confirmed.
The client requires replacement of the heavy font, but the freelancer's specific Gotham Pro choice lacks explicit client acceptance.
Git-based deployment is raised as a question, but the evidence does not establish it as a required deployment mechanism distinct from Docker deployment to the Ubuntu VPS.
